description: This file defines the 'ActivityA' class for an Android application, demonstrating activity lifecycle callback methods and navigation to other activities.

classes.name: ActivityA
classes.description: An Android Activity class demonstrating lifecycle callback methods and navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, setting the layout, initializing variables, and setting lifecycle status.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Updates status when the activity becomes visible.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Updates status when activity gains focus.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Updates status when activity loses focus.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Updates status when activity is no longer visible.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Updates status and clears tracker when activity is destroyed.
